questions.question: List the names of students majoring in Computer Science.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = 'Computer Science'

questions.question: What is the average GPA for each major?
questions.sql: SELECT major, AVG(gpa) FROM students GROUP BY major

questions.question: Which student has the highest GPA? Return their name.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many students are enrolled in each course? Return the course title and the count.
questions.sql: SELECT c.title, COUNT(*) FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id

questions.question: List the names of students who are not enrolled in any course.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments)

questions.question: What is the total number of credits each enrolled student is taking? Return the student name and total credits.
questions.sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(c.credits) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY s.id

questions.question: Find the names of students whose GPA is above the average GPA of all students.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa > (SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students)

questions.question: List the titles of Mathematics department courses worth more than 3 credits.
questions.sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE dept = 'Mathematics' AND credits > 3
